summary: Secluso is a video surveillance system designed for Raspberry Pi hardware. It offers end-to-end encrypted remote access alongside mobile applications to handle live feeds, alerts, and playback of recorded footage.
goodFor: This application suits individuals who want a self-hosted home security camera setup centred around low-power ARM hardware and mobile access.
watchOut: With a modest repository popularity and steady maintenance status, you may encounter edge cases or hardware-specific driver limitations that are common in DIY camera setups.
deployNotes: As a compiled Rust application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for recorded video files and a reverse proxy to handle secure TLS termination for remote access.
